scope: The Compiler returns the Language-owned source_module test inventory from the same frontend result used to verify callable roots and emit application-build/7. A fresh process can locate a prior artifact candidate across root snapshots; changed source still runs the full frontend before executable-closure reuse. Exact fresh-process reuse preserves the inventory; edits refresh source spans or the affected test identity, and invalid input publishes neither inventory nor artifact. A selected zero-argument source Test subset can be emitted with the production entry, selected from the returned inventory, and executed in one canonical VM batch with Stage-0 agreement. The real seven-case mncs-test self-suite also selects arithmetic and skipped by exact Language-issued identities, retains the full source inventory, and executes only those two selected callables twice on the emitted artifact with Stage-0 agreement; stale selection rows and arguments for unselected cases are rejected before dispatch. A bounded parameterized Test slice binds two typed u64 inputs, one signed i64, one bool, and one byte input to the Language-issued signature and repeats its typed TestResult through the same artifact with Stage-0 agreement; wrong arity and integer wire type are rejected before VM dispatch. The batch adapter accepts a generic Test only when its seed resolves to a concrete callable. The Compiler removes the generic template from executable exports, lowers its verified seeded specialization, and admits the selected Test when the exact generic-entrypoint spelling is present. A generic Test with independent Nat bounds 2 and 3 executes twice by inventory identity with two typed byte inputs and matches Stage-0. Wrong specialization arity and malformed sequence wire values are rejected. A controlled failure-isolation inventory runs a failing typed TestResult followed by a passing case, twice in the batch adapter and twice in one retained VM process; all four results complete and match Stage-0, and the typed failure does not stop later session calls. A live canonical VM process is then killed during a bounded inventory Test call. It publishes no result file; a fresh VM process executes the next Test twice from the exact same artifact and matches Stage-0. A retained mncs.vm.session/1 serve process returns one TestResult before interruption, publishes no response for an in-flight call when killed, and after restart replays that call by its same ID, then completes a later call from the same artifact. Recovered typed results match Stage-0 and the earlier result. This proves local process restart and caller-managed replay on the same artifact; Forge/Environment durable session state and exactly-once execution are outside this proof. A second workload reads the real mncs-test self-suite sources and the task module at the Compiler-pinned Language revision. One application-build/8 all-source selection resolves all seven compiler-inventoried TestResult callables from the Language inventory and emits a verified artifact; one canonical VM batch runs two rounds of all seven tests in the same admitted artifact/session. All 14 results match Stage-0 and the second round matches the first, including six passes and the typed skip result. A second mncs.vm.session/1 serve process then executes the same 14 individual calls across two rounds with artifact-bound Language Test identities; a mismatched Test identity is rejected without stopping the retained session, and every typed result matches both the batch path and Stage-0. A comment-only source shift in the real suite reuses every produced Language v3 body fact while refreshing all current Test source spans and preserving semantic Test identities and the executable artifact. A semantics-preserving edit to the imported assertions.from_assertion helper rechecks exactly that body and its six real self-suite callers, reuses all unrelated Language body facts and declaration facts, and regenerates the artifact. All 14 calls on the new artifact match Stage-0 across two rounds. This does not migrate the production runner or add Forge integration. The Environment provider adapter also publishes /7 after resolving the Language-issued source Test identities. The additional cache policy check built the same source under baseline, changed capability, and changed effect-assumption requests; each variant received a distinct cache key and ran the frontend, while a fresh process reused only the exact effect-assumption request. Language verified-fact reuse is recorded by both real self-suite comment and reachable-body edits above.
